title: Work on the go
body:
In years gone by, if you worked in an office that's where work was limited to. Now with mobile and web apps like Google Sheets your work goes where you go - the office, at home, at a coffee shop, the airport etc.

sheets is not only great because of its integration with Google Drive and other Google products, but as a standalone app it great too.
author: Brendan Ihmig
